title: Name change - federal records checklist
facts: A legal name change after marriage, divorce or court order does not automatically update every federal record.
Social Security records should generally be updated so the name associated with the Social Security number matches tax and employment records.
A U.S. passport name change follows Department of State procedures that depend on when the passport was issued and the documentation supporting the change.
USCIS records and immigration documents use separate procedures for noncitizens and should not be assumed to update from an SSA change.
